# Disagreement Log — 1 Clement Chapter 10

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Agents:** EMET (literal) | LOGOS (formal) | PNEUMA (dynamic)
**Total Disagreements:** 10

---

## Disagreement 1 — 10:1 "Friend" vs. "the Friend" vs. "God's Friend"

- **EMET:** "called 'Friend'"
- **LOGOS:** "called 'the Friend'"
- **PNEUMA:** "called 'God's Friend'"
- **Greek:** *ho philos prosagoreutheisa* — having been called the friend
- **Ruling:** SOPHIA uses "called 'the Friend.'" The definite article in Greek (*ho philos*) makes this a proper title. PNEUMA's "God's Friend" adds an explicit genitive not in the text here.

---

## Disagreement 2 — 10:2 "small land / feeble clan / little house" vs. "small land / small people / small household"

- **EMET:** "small land, feeble clan, little house"
- **LOGOS:** "small land, small people, small household"
- **PNEUMA:** "small piece of land, small group of people, modest home"
- **Greek:** *mikran gēn, kai mikran suggenian kai mikrotera oikon* — small land, small kindred, smaller house
- **Ruling:** SOPHIA uses "a small land, a small kindred, and a little house." LOGOS's consistency ("small...small...small") preserves the Greek anaphora. PNEUMA's "modest" understates.

---

## Disagreement 3 — 10:3 "magnify your name" vs. "make your name great" vs. "make your name great"

- **EMET:** "I will magnify your name"
- **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "I will make your name great"
- **Greek (LXX Gen 12:2):** *megalunō to onoma sou* — I will make great your name
- **Ruling:** SOPHIA uses "I will make your name great" (LOGOS/PNEUMA). More natural English for the LXX expression.

---

## Disagreement 4 — 10:3 "tribes" vs. "tribes" vs. "peoples"

- **EMET/LOGOS:** "all the tribes of the earth"
- **PNEUMA:** "all the peoples of the earth"
- **Greek (LXX Gen 12:3):** *pasai hai phulai tēs gēs* — all the tribes of the earth
- **Ruling:** SOPHIA uses "all the tribes of the earth" (EMET/LOGOS). *Phulē* = tribe; PNEUMA's "peoples" is a loose paraphrase.

---

## Disagreement 5 — 10:4 "Lift up your eyes" vs. "Look up with your eyes" vs. "Look around you"

- **EMET:** "Lift up your eyes and look"
- **LOGOS:** "Look up with your eyes and see"
- **PNEUMA:** "Look around you in every direction"
- **Greek (LXX Gen 13:14):** *ananepsas tois ophthalmois* — having looked up with the eyes
- **Ruling:** SOPHIA uses "Lift up your eyes and look" (EMET). Preserves the physical upward gesture of the LXX.

---

## Disagreement 6 — 10:4 "seed" vs. "descendants" — LXX term

- **EMET:** "your seed"
- **LOGOS:** "your descendants"
- **PNEUMA:** "your descendants"
- **Greek:** *to sperma sou* — your seed
- **Ruling:** SOPHIA uses "your seed." When quoting the LXX directly, "seed" should be preserved as it carries the messianic typological weight that Paul exploits in Gal 3:16.

---

## Disagreement 7 — 10:5 "believed God" vs. "believed God" vs. "believed God" — all agree

- Unanimous agreement. Recorded.

---

## Disagreement 8 — 10:5 "reckoned unto him as righteousness" vs. "credited to him as righteousness" vs. "counted that as righteousness"

- **EMET:** "reckoned unto him as righteousness"
- **LOGOS:** "credited to him as righteousness"
- **PNEUMA:** "God counted that as righteousness"
- **Greek (LXX Gen 15:6):** *elogisthē autō eis dikaiosunēn* — it was reckoned to him for righteousness
- **Ruling:** SOPHIA uses "reckoned to him as righteousness" (EMET). This is the standard rendering used across the NT citations of this verse; consistency with tradition is important here.

---

## Disagreement 9 — 10:6 "faith and hospitality" — all agree on the pairing

- All agents agree. Recorded for completeness.

---

## Disagreement 10 — 10:6 "showed him" vs. "pointed out to him" vs. "designated"

- **EMET:** "mountains which God showed him"
- **LOGOS:** "mountains that God pointed out to him"
- **PNEUMA:** "the mountain God designated"
- **Greek:** *deiknuō* — to show/indicate/point out
- **Ruling:** SOPHIA uses "mountains which God showed him" (EMET). The plural "mountains" preserves ambiguity; the LXX says "one of the mountains I will show you" in Gen 22:2.

---

*End of disagreement log for 1 Clement Chapter 10.*
